expectations.text: Defines non-sensitive metadata that distinguishes not-configured/not-attempted from a completed OCR attempt.
expectations.evidence: Response defines state values including deferred_no_token, not_attempted, in_progress, and completed with attempted, model, counts, safe failures, and no secret fields.

expectations.text: Backfills only image-bearing pre-OCR caches after token configuration, then remains idempotent even if one image failed.
expectations.evidence: eligible_for_ocr requires a configured token, image_count > 0, allowed unattempted state, and attempted=false. Finalization marks completed/attempted=true even for partial failures.

expectations.text: Keeps the enriched canonical source text as the report/summarization input.
expectations.evidence: Response names canonical_source_text as the only input to summaries, Q&A/RAG, export, daily, and weekly reports.

expectations.text: Includes deterministic tests for one-time refresh, partial failure, order, and secret non-disclosure.
expectations.evidence: Tests explicitly cover legacy backfill once, partial failure without reattempt, completion-order independence, concurrent readers, downstream consistency, and token sentinel non-disclosure.

eval_feedback.overall: This is a discriminating cache-idempotency response: the completed state explicitly includes partial failures.
